legacy.title: Built by farmers. Growing for six decades.
legacy.body: Founded as a cooperative sugar mill by Late Shri Shankarraoji Kolhe Saheb, the group now spans sugar and the Amrut Sugar brand, distilleries, chemicals, dairy, energy, agri-inputs, fisheries, pharma, education, banking and IT.

founder.title: A cooperative idea that grew into an institution.
founder.p1: In 1960, Sahakar Maharshi Shankarrao Kolhe (1929–2022), former Minister of Maharashtra, brought the farmers of Kopargaon together to build their own sugar mill. What began as a cooperative of cane growers became an integrated rural enterprise — in sugar, green energy, agri-inputs, pharmaceuticals and education.
founder.p2: In 1983 he founded the Sanjivani Rural Education Society, so that the children of farmers and workers could become engineers, pharmacists and leaders without leaving rural Maharashtra.

milestone.title: India's first cooperative compressed biogas plant.
milestone.body: Inaugurated by the Union Minister of Cooperation at Kopargaon, our multi-feed CBG and potash granule plant turns molasses, press mud and crop residue into clean fuel and fertiliser — a model the Centre plans to take to more cooperative sugar mills.

waterConservation.title: Sanjivani Yuva Pratishthan spreads awareness on water conservation with symbolic 'Dushkalasur' burning at Tehsil Maidan
waterConservation.excerpt: The 'Dushkalasur Burning and Water Conservation Sankalp' programme at Tehsil Maidan, Kopargaon, turned the traditional Mahishasura theme into a message against drought and water scarcity, urging citizens to adopt sustainable water management and reduce wastage.

rakshaRath.title: 'Ek Rakhi Soldiers' Raksha Rath reaches the Kutch border, carrying the love of thousands of Indians
rakshaRath.excerpt: The Raksha Rath, which set off from Shirdi, completed a journey across Maharashtra and Gujarat to the India border, carrying thousands of rakhis and heartfelt messages from citizens to the soldiers stationed at the nation's frontiers.

hospitalOnWheels.title: Hospital on Wheels transforming rural healthcare in Kopargaon
hospitalOnWheels.excerpt: For 25 years the Hospital on Wheels initiative has brought essential healthcare directly to rural communities, covering nearly 90 villages across Kopargaon Taluka for residents with limited access to medical facilities.
